title: Brookfield raises $2bln for PIF-anchored Middle East fund
summary: The Canadian asset manager is also committing $500 million to the new private equity fund that will invest in businesses based in Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East
thbAction: Map the news to THB's provider CRM for referral growth, patient lifecycle engagement, and multi-facility relationship management across hospital and provider networks.
contentHtml:
The Brookfield logo in this illustration taken April 24, 2026. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration.

The Canadian asset manager is also committing $500 million to the new private equity fund that will invest in businesses based in Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East

Staff Writer ,  ZAWYA

Brookfield has raised $2 billion in the first close of its Middle East-focused fund anchored by Saudi Arabia sovereign investor, the Public Investment Fund (PIF), along with group of anchor investors and institutional partners.
